verdict.rationale: LocalAI is an HTTP server with an OpenAI-compatible API on port 8080, and the documented Docker command publishes that port on the host. Its multi-user auth with per-user API keys and its distributed worker nodes imply clients on other machines, which delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit docs on binding to a LAN interface (e.g. host/address flags) or LAN access from other devices, and independent hands-on confirmation of remote-device access.
